nodes.label: FinRL Adaptive Trading Agent (PPO)
nodes.rationale: PPO agent replacing fixed percentile thresholds with continuous action space [-1, 1]. State: ILI, Z-scores, Beta, Volatility Regime, recent returns, portfolio exposure. Reward: maximize Sharpe with risk penalties.

nodes.label: TD3 Continuous Action Space Execution
nodes.rationale: Twin-Delayed DDPG with Actor-Critic architecture. Dynamic position sizing (23% instead of fixed 5%). Logarithmic return reward. Alternative B pluggable agent.

nodes.label: AgnosticAggregator (Online Learning/Regret Minimization)
nodes.rationale: Aggregates multiple weight-sets using regret-minimization algorithm (Exponential Weights). Self-optimizing weight system for non-ergodic financial data (SSRN-5242085).

nodes.label: Multi-Model Tournament Benchmarking
nodes.rationale: Benchmark ILI against XGBoost, LSTM, MLP, SVM. Voting Classifier requires ILI signal to be voted on by at least one other ML model. Regime-specific benchmarking (Uptrend/Sideways/Downtrend).

nodes.label: LangGraph ReAct Agent Architecture
nodes.rationale: ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) loop using LangGraph for multi-step reasoning. Three specialist agents (Macro, Sentiment, Technicals) with ensemble supervisor. Alternative D pluggable agent.

nodes.label: SHAP Model Explainability Service
nodes.rationale: SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) for DRL/ML agent interpretability. Top 3 Drivers display for every ACTIONABLE signal. Simulation-to-Reality Gauge for model drift detection.
